configurePresets.name: portable
configurePresets.displayName: Portable -- no proprietary component (Eigen solver backend)
configurePresets.description: Builds and runs the whole suite without Intel oneMKL, so every published number can be reproduced by a reviewer who has none. The results must match the msvc-rwdi build; that they do is what the claim 'a result does not depend on the configuration' means here.

configurePresets.name: engine
configurePresets.displayName: Engine only -- physics without schema or IO
configurePresets.description: Builds math, linsolve, geometry, mesh, materials, fem and analysis, plus exactly the tests confined to those modules. That this configures, builds and passes is the build-level proof that the physics needs no file format and no scripting.
